newsitem.title: POLAND: ING BARINGS RATES IZOLACJA AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: ING BARINGS RATES IZOLACJA AS BUY.

text.p: ING Baring Securities Limited recommended to buy Polish insulation materials maker Izolacja SA shares, saying the firm's prospected earnings growth made its current valuation very attractive, ING Baring said.

ING Baring said in its April Eastern European Research Izolacja's net profit was likely to rise to 15.4 million zlotys, up from 11.4 million in 1996, on sales of 160.7 million and 127.2 million respectively.

"The valuation of the company at 13.3 times 1997 profits is well below and prospective earnings above the industrial average, management appears efficient and capable and we therefore recommend a buy," it said.
It also said Izolacja faced little domestic competition and in case of rising demand it could easily double its capacity at relatively marginal costs.
Izolacja was trading at 177.5 zlotys on April 21 when the report was issued. It traded at 180 on Tuesday.
